periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Sub-vertical, approximately 80 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, with a slight outward tilt at the superior end.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval; vertical length is approximately 1.7 times the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Notable downward tapering with the inferior point narrower and more pointed than the superior curve.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped profile visible at the posterior boundary where the black fur meets the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Thick; the band covers the full shoulder width and extends significantly down the visible forelimbs.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Separation distance is approximately 1.2 times the horizontal width of a single ear unit.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The viewer-right ear is smoothly rounded; the viewer-left ear exhibits a more acute, slightly pointed apex.

other_distinctive_markers: Pinkish-toned lighting or color cast on the right side of the white dorsal fur.
